title: Shared Lockers for Missed Deliveries
transcript: A set of public delivery lockers is being installed outside the Westgate Post Office. Residents will be able to have parcels sent there if they know they will not be at home. When a parcel arrives, the customer will receive a message containing a code to open the locker. The lockers will be available day and night, even when the post office is closed. Parcels left for more than three days will be taken inside and kept at the counter.

questions.prompt: What will the customer need to open a locker?
options: A key from a postal worker.
A copy of a payment receipt.
A card issued by the council.
questions.explanation: 包裹到达时收到含有开柜验证码的消息。

questions.prompt: What happens to parcels left for over three days?
options: They are delivered to the customer's home.
They are moved to the post office counter.
They are moved to a larger locker.
questions.answer: They are moved to the post office counter.
questions.explanation: 超过三天未领取的包裹会转到邮局柜台保管。
